name: JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa
positioning: Family resort in Surfers Paradise on the Gold Coast, with a saltwater lagoon streaming with tropical fish, a private marina on the Nerang River and Spa by JW
best_for: Families wanting Family by JW activities, lagoon snorkelling and daily fish feeding
Travellers who want jet ski tours and water activities from a private marina

facts.text: The resort is in the town of Surfers Paradise on the Gold Coast.
Guestrooms have views of the Pacific Ocean or the Gold Coast Hinterland.
Ocean King rooms have a private balcony with ocean views and views of the resort's Lagoon Pool.
The resort was originally built in 1993.
There is also a freshwater pool with a children's slide.
The water sports kiosk has snorkels, flippers and motorized aquatic scooters for hire.
Spa by JW treatments focus on four benefits: Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew.
Spa by JW has a steam room and separate men's and women's lounges.
Family by JW offers activities such as the Mini Misono sushi-making class, family yoga and herb planting in the JW Garden.
Odyssey Jet Ski Tours runs guided jet ski tours from the resort's private marina through the Broadwater.
Misono is a teppanyaki-style restaurant with a whiskey bar with an outdoor terrace, an Izakaya and a live sushi table.
Guests receive a signature welcome ritual with lavender iced tea on arrival.

highlights.text: The saltwater lagoon has white sandy beaches, a swim-up grotto and waterfalls, and is streaming with tropical fish.
The resort has a private marina behind the pool area, on the Gold Coast's Nerang River.
Guests can join the daily feeding of the lagoon's tropical fish, followed by a JW Garden tour.
The Executive Suites are on the resort's top floors, with panoramic views of the Gold Coast Hinterland and Pacific Ocean and a separate lounge room.
Australian design studio DBI, the property's original architects and interior designers, reimagined the resort drawing inspiration from the Gold Coast Hinterland.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the popular tourist area can be crowded during peak seasons.
